questions.question: A cube has six faces. What shape is each face?
questions.explain: Each face of a cube is a square with four equal sides. A rectangle has two long and two short sides, so it is not the same shape.

questions.question: You hold a small wooden cube. What 2D shape is on the top face?
questions.explain: The top face of a cube is a square. A cube is the 3D shape itself, but each flat face is a 2D square.

questions.question: A dice is a cube. How many faces does it have?
questions.explain: A cube has six faces: top, bottom, front, back, left, and right. You can count all six on a dice.

questions.question: You look at one face of a cube. It has four equal sides and four corners. What 2D shape is it?
questions.explain: A face with four equal sides and four corners is a square. A rectangle has two long and two short sides, so it is different.

questions.question: A shoebox is a rectangular prism. You look at the front face. What 2D shape do you see?
questions.explain: The front face of a shoebox is a rectangle. It has four sides, but the top and bottom are longer than the left and right.

questions.question: A cereal box is a rectangular prism. You open the top. What 2D shape is the opening?
questions.explain: The top opening of a cereal box is a rectangle. A cube is a 3D shape, not a 2D face shape.

questions.question: You count the flat faces of a rectangular prism on your desk. How many do you find?
questions.explain: A rectangular prism has six flat faces: top, bottom, front, back, left, and right. Count each one on a box.

questions.question: Your lunchbox is a rectangular prism. The front face is a rectangle. What shape is the top face?
questions.explain: The top face of a rectangular prism is also a rectangle. A rectangular prism's faces are rectangles or squares, never circles or triangles.

questions.question: A can of soup is a cylinder. How many flat faces does it have, and what shape are they?
questions.explain: A cylinder has two flat faces, the top and the bottom, and both are circles. The curved side is not a flat face.

questions.question: Maya says the flat faces of a cylinder are rectangles. What did she get wrong?
options: a cylinder has no flat faces
a cylinder has three flat faces
questions.explain: The flat faces of a cylinder are circles, not rectangles. Maya mixed up the shape of the face with a different 2D shape.

questions.question: Leo puts a can of beans on top of a cube block. He traces the flat top of the can and one face of the cube. What two shapes does he trace?
questions.explain: The flat top of a can traces a circle, and one face of a cube traces a square. The can is a cylinder, but the flat shape it leaves is a circle.

questions.question: Nina's tea box is a rectangular prism. Four of its faces are rectangles. The two end faces are as tall as they are wide. What shape are the end faces?
questions.explain: A face that is as tall as it is wide has four equal sides, so it is a square. A rectangular prism can have square faces, not only rectangles.

questions.question: Ben says his tissue box is a square. Which sentence fixes his mistake?
options: Its faces are rectangles, so it is a rectangular prism.
Its faces are triangles, so it is just a flat triangle.
Its faces are round circles, so it is a cylinder.
Its faces are all squares, so it is a square box.
questions.explain: A tissue box is a 3D object, so it is a rectangular prism; square is the name of a flat shape. Look at a face first: each face of the box is a rectangle.

questions.question: Mia dips the flat end of a can in paint. She stamps it on paper 2 times. Then she stamps one face of a sugar cube 3 times. How many circles are on her paper?
questions.explain: The flat end of a can is a circle, so the 2 can stamps make 2 circles. A cube face is a square, so those 3 stamps are not circles.
